mapper.update: UPDATE sub_task SET task_id = #{et.taskId}, module_id = #{et.moduleId}, title = #{et.title}, deliverable = #{et.deliverable}, acceptance = #{et.acceptance}, priority = #{et.priority}, status = #{et.status}, assigned_agent_id = #{et.assignedAgentId}, content = #{et.content}, context = #{et.context,typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.handlers.JacksonTypeHandler}::jsonb, score_factors = #{et.scoreFactors,typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.handlers.JacksonTypeHandler}::jsonb, composite_score = #{et.compositeScore}, score_grade = #{et.scoreGrade}, deadline = #{et.deadline}, rework_count = #{et.reworkCount}, complete_time = #{et.completeTime}, version = #{et.version}, timeout_count = #{et.timeoutCount}, external_fallback_count = #{et.externalFallbackCount}, reassign_attempt_count = #{et.reassignAttemptCount}, update_by = #{et.updateBy}, update_time = #{et.updateTime} WHERE id = #{et.id} AND version = #{MP_OPTLOCK_VERSION_ORIGINAL} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE sub_task SET assigned_agent_id = #{agentId}, status = 'ASSIGNED', version = version + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{subTaskId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND (assigned_agent_id IS NULL OR assigned_agent_id = #{agentId}) AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT st.id FROM sub_task st WHERE st.status = 'PENDING' AND st.assigned_agent_id IS NULL AND st.deleted = 0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM agent_execution_record aer WHERE aer.sub_task_id = st.id ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM agent_execution_record aer2 WHERE aer2.sub_task_id = st.id AND aer2.status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') ) ORDER BY st.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
